title: Magnetic field magnitude
description: Essential: The final answer for part (1) must be expressed as B = 3mg/(4IL) or an equivalent simplified form.

title: Normal force magnitude
description: Essential: The final answer for part (2) must be expressed as (27/20)mg or an equivalent simplified form.

title: Force balance for static equilibrium
description: Important: For part (1), the solution must resolve forces on the rod, equating the magnetic force up the incline to the component of gravity down the incline.

title: Ampere force application
description: Important: The solution must correctly apply F = BIL to relate the magnetic field to the force on the current-carrying conductor.

title: Force balance for moving rod
description: Important: For part (2), the solution must set up the correct force balance perpendicular to the incline to find the normal force, accounting for both magnetic and gravitational components.

title: Trigonometric function use
description: Important: The solution must correctly apply sin(37°) = 0.6 and cos(37°) = 0.8 in force component calculations.

title: Direction of magnetic force
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the direction of the magnetic force (using the right-hand rule) is incorrectly determined for either part, leading to wrong force balance.

title: Component resolution error
description: Pitfall: Penalize if force components (gravity, normal, magnetic) are resolved incorrectly relative to the inclined plane.

title: Algebraic simplification
description: Optional: Award credit for clear, step-by-step algebraic manipulation leading to the final simplified answers.
